facts.fact: La Presse reports Orange Tunisie announced on 24 June 2026 that MEDUSA is in operational service via the Bizerte landing station, carrying its first international traffic; four fibre pairs of 24 Tbps each.

systems.owner: Orange Tunisie (Tunisian section and Bizerte landing station)

note: DIDON (in service 2014) is named as an earlier Orange cable but its current service status is not stated, so no fact.
